resources.label: Experience Cloud ID
resources.description: The identifier Adobe assigns to a visitor or device and shares across Experience Cloud applications and Experience Platform, one of the identities the Identity Graph resolves to a person.

resources.label: Experience Data Model
resources.description: Adobe's open specification for describing customer-experience data as schemas composed of classes and field groups, so data from different systems is consistent across Experience Platform and third-party systems.

resources.label: Experience Fragments
resources.description: Experience Manager's reusable groups of components with layout — a complete piece of an experience placed across pages and channels so the same composed content is maintained once.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager
resources.description: Adobe's enterprise content-management application, combining web content management and digital asset management to build, manage and deliver web, mobile and headless experiences.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Assets
resources.description: Experience Manager's digital asset management application — storing, tagging, governing and distributing approved assets at enterprise scale, with renditions for channel-ready delivery.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Edge Delivery Services
resources.description: Experience Manager's delivery architecture that compiles document-based or code-based authoring into pre-rendered pages served from the edge.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Forms
resources.description: Experience Manager's application for digital enrolment — adaptive forms and automated document communications connected to back-end workflows and e-signature.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Guides
resources.description: Experience Manager's DITA-based component content-management application for authoring, reviewing and publishing technical documentation.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Screens
resources.description: Experience Manager's digital-signage application for authoring and operating in-venue screen experiences from the same content platform as web channels.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Sites
resources.description: Experience Manager's web content-management application for authoring, managing and delivering websites, including headless delivery.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Manager Sites Optimizer
resources.description: The companion to Experience Manager Sites that finds problems in page loading, component usage and content delivery and recommends fixes across performance, accessibility, SEO and engagement.

resources.label: Experience Modernization Agent
resources.description: Adobe's site-migration agent in Experience Manager Edge Delivery Services that analyses an existing website, maps its pages to blocks, extracts the design system and generates the code that onboards the site, working in the Experience Modernization Console.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform
resources.description: Adobe's customer-data foundation for Experience Cloud — XDM schemas, Real-Time Customer Profile, segmentation and data governance — on which Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer and Customer Journey Analytics run.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Assurance
resources.description: Experience Platform's validation tool, used chiefly for mobile apps, that shows events and Places Service location events live as they flow through the Edge Network.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Auditor
resources.description: The former standalone system that graded Experience Cloud implementations, whose tests now run in the Experience Platform Debugger.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection
resources.description: Experience Platform's group of data-capture technologies — Web and Mobile SDKs, datastreams, Tags and event forwarding — for collecting customer-experience data client- and server-side and routing it to Adobe and non-Adobe destinations.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Debugger
resources.description: Experience Platform's browser extension that inspects and validates Web SDK, Tags and Edge Network implementations.

resources.label: Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network
resources.description: Experience Platform's globally distributed edge-server network that receives data from websites and apps through the Web and Mobile SDKs and returns audience qualifications and personalised offers, hosting Tags and event forwarding at the edge.

resources.label: Experience Production Agent
resources.description: Adobe's content-production agent in Experience Manager that updates existing content fragments, pages, forms and assets and creates new forms and communications, replacing manual high-volume content work.

resources.label: Experimentation Agent
resources.description: Adobe's experimentation agent in Journey Optimizer Experimentation Accelerator that summarises tests, analyses results by audience, explains what worked and proposes the next test.

resources.label: Adobe Express
resources.description: Adobe's template-led content-creation application for making graphics, social posts, short videos and documents quickly, used across creative-production and marketing contexts.

resources.label: Federated Search
resources.description: Experience Cloud's cross-application search — one permission-aware search surface over business objects such as audiences, journeys, datasets and assets across the Experience Platform applications.

resources.label: Field Discovery Agent
resources.description: Adobe's functional agent in Experience Platform, used by the Audience and Data Engineering agents, that discovers the XDM fields needed to design audiences and schemas.

resources.label: Fill & Sign
resources.description: Document Cloud's capability for filling in forms and e-signing them yourself, available in Acrobat desktop, Acrobat web and Reader and as a separate mobile app.

resources.label: Adobe Fill & Sign
resources.description: Adobe's mobile application for filling in forms and signing them, backed by the Document Cloud Fill & Sign capability.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly
resources.description: Adobe's generative-AI creative application for generating and editing images, video, vectors and audio with commercially safe models, available on the web and integrated across Creative Cloud.

resources.label: Firefly AI Assistant
resources.description: Adobe's conversational creative agent that turns an outcome described in natural language into a multi-step workflow run across Firefly, Creative Cloud applications and generative models, leaving the results editable.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Boards
resources.description: Firefly's collaborative ideation application — shared web canvases for exploring, generating and organising visual concepts with Firefly and partner models.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Creative Production
resources.description: Firefly's governed production application for enterprises — creative actions, orchestration and integrations that automate repetitive production and generate consistent on-brand variations.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Custom Models
resources.description: Firefly models fine-tuned on an organisation's own brand assets — styles, products, characters — that generate on-brand imagery usable in Firefly, Express and GenStudio.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Design Intelligence
resources.description: Firefly's enterprise design-system application in which design teams codify brand guidelines as trained style definitions that creators then apply to produce compliant, contextually adapted assets.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Foundry
resources.description: Adobe's managed service in which Adobe builds, trains and runs bespoke generative models on an enterprise's own IP, surfacing them in Adobe applications and Firefly Services APIs through a Foundry web application.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Services
resources.description: Adobe's enterprise APIs exposing Firefly and Creative Cloud automation for high-volume content production — generating variants, localising and refreshing assets programmatically.

resources.label: Adobe Firefly Studio
resources.description: The enterprise edition of Firefly, delivered on the web without desktop applications, in which business teams generate on-brand images, video, audio and designs with Adobe and partner models under governance and shared credits.

resources.label: Firefly Video Model
resources.description: The video-generation model in the Firefly family for commercially safe text-to-video and image-to-video generation trained on licensed content.

resources.label: Adobe Fonts
resources.description: Adobe's font service — a library of licensed typefaces activated directly in Creative Cloud applications and on the web.

resources.label: Adobe Frame.io
resources.description: Adobe's cloud video review and collaboration application — frame-accurate comments, version management and camera-to-cloud uploads connecting production to post.

resources.label: Adobe FrameMaker
resources.description: Adobe's technical-authoring application for long, structured documents — XML and DITA authoring, templates and publishing to print, PDF and the web.

resources.label: Adobe Fresco
resources.description: Adobe's drawing and painting application for stylus and touch devices, with live brushes that behave like physical watercolour and oil.

resources.label: Generate Podcast
resources.description: Acrobat's generative-audio capability that converts document content into a two-host conversational podcast in condensed or deep-dive script styles.

resources.label: Generative Expand
resources.description: Photoshop's Firefly-powered capability that extends an image beyond its original borders, generating matching content to fill the enlarged canvas.

resources.label: Generative Fill
resources.description: Photoshop's Firefly-powered capability that generates new image content inside a selected region from a text prompt, matching the lighting and perspective of the surrounding image.

resources.label: Adobe GenStudio
resources.description: Adobe's product family of generative-AI content-supply-chain applications — planning, creating, activating and measuring on-brand marketing content — connecting Workfront, Firefly, Experience Manager and Content Analytics.

resources.label: Adobe GenStudio for Commerce Media Networks
resources.description: GenStudio's application that lets a retailer's commerce media network enable brands to launch on-brand advertising campaigns, building advertiser profiles and creative assets from product listings and activating them in the retailer's ad network.

resources.label: Adobe GenStudio for Content Marketing
resources.description: GenStudio's application that applies the GenStudio creation-and-activation pipeline to content-marketing assets — briefs to on-brand marketing content — rather than to paid-media ads.

resources.label: Adobe GenStudio for Performance Marketing
resources.description: GenStudio's application for planning, creating and optimising on-brand campaign assets across paid media, email and display advertising.

resources.label: Adobe GenStudio Foundation
resources.description: GenStudio's unifying application that brings campaign plans, projects, assets and performance from the content-supply-chain applications into one view.

resources.label: GenStudio Services
resources.description: GenStudio's public REST API for retrieving approved experiences, listing and filtering experience summaries and downloading assets, so GenStudio content flows into external workflows.

resources.label: Identity Graph
resources.description: Experience Platform's map of the relationships between a person's identifiers — device IDs, email hashes, CRM IDs — that resolves fragmented records across channels to one individual.

resources.label: Experience Platform Identity Service
resources.description: Experience Platform's identity capability that bridges a person's identifiers across devices and systems and builds the Identity Graph that feeds Real-Time Customer Profile; it is distinct from the Visitor ID Service.

resources.label: Adobe Illustrator
resources.description: Adobe's professional vector-graphics application — logos, icons, illustration and type built from scalable paths rather than pixels.

resources.label: Adobe Illustrator (web)
resources.description: The browser surface of Illustrator for vector editing in lightweight and collaborative workflows.

resources.label: Adobe InCopy
resources.description: Adobe's editorial writing and copy-fitting application that lets writers work inside InDesign layouts in parallel with designers.

resources.label: Adobe InDesign
resources.description: Adobe's professional page-layout and desktop-publishing application for print and digital documents — books, magazines, brochures and interactive PDFs.

resources.label: Journey Agent
resources.description: Adobe's journey-orchestration agent in Journey Optimizer that builds journeys from natural-language prompts, analyses fallout, detects scheduling and audience conflicts and proposes adjustments before publication.

resources.label: Adobe Journey Optimizer
resources.description: Experience Platform's journey application — orchestrating and delivering individual customer journeys, triggered messages, campaigns and offers across email, mobile and web from the Real-Time Customer Profile.

resources.label: Adobe Journey Optimizer B2B Edition
resources.description: The buying-group edition of Journey Optimizer — orchestrating account and buying-group journeys for B2B in coordination with Marketo Engage.

resources.label: Adobe Journey Optimizer Experimentation Accelerator
resources.description: Journey Optimizer's experimentation application — centralising past and active experiments, analysing results by audience and accelerating the design of new tests.

resources.label: Adobe Journey Optimizer Loyalty
resources.description: Journey Optimizer's loyalty-orchestration application, built with agentic AI at its core, for designing gamified loyalty challenges, messaging members across channels and ingesting data from external loyalty platforms.

resources.label: Adobe Learning Manager
resources.description: Adobe's cloud learning-management application for delivering and tracking training for customers, partners and employees.

resources.label: Adobe Lightroom
resources.description: Adobe's cloud-centric photo editing and organisation application, syncing originals and edits across desktop, web and mobile.

resources.label: Adobe Lightroom Classic
resources.description: Adobe's desktop-centric, file-based photo-workflow application — local cataloguing, batch editing and print output for photographers who keep originals on disk.

resources.label: Adobe Lightroom (web)
resources.description: The browser surface of Lightroom for viewing, culling and editing synced photos from any machine.

resources.label: LLM Optimization Agent
resources.description: Adobe's generative-AI quality agent in Brand Visibility, formerly LLM Optimizer, that evaluates and improves AI outputs and configurations, detecting regressions and suggesting better prompts or guardrails.

resources.label: Adobe Brand Visibility
resources.description: Adobe's generative-engine-optimisation application that improves how a brand's content is surfaced and cited by AI assistants and LLM-powered search, combining the capabilities of the former LLM Optimizer with Semrush's AI optimisation, with dashboards for brand presence and AI-referred traffic.

resources.label: Loyalty Agent
resources.description: Adobe's loyalty agent in Journey Optimizer Loyalty that gives challenge insights and recommendations, monitors loyalty KPIs and detects anomalies through a conversational interface.

resources.label: Adobe Marketing Agent
resources.description: Adobe's agent that brings the skills of the Experience Platform agents — operational insights, data insights, audiences and journeys — plus Experience Manager asset discovery and Workfront workflows into the conversational tools marketers already work in, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Gemini Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude, through open agent protocols.

resources.label: Marketing Workflow
resources.description: Adobe Experience Cloud's product category for planning and managing marketing work — projects, workflows, approvals and resourcing.

resources.label: Adobe Marketo Engage
resources.description: Adobe's B2B marketing-automation application — lead management, nurturing, scoring, email marketing and account-based marketing tied to CRM.

resources.label: Adobe Marketo Measure
resources.description: Adobe's B2B marketing-attribution application — multi-touch attribution and return-on-investment measurement tied into CRM and the marketing platform.

resources.label: Adobe Media Encoder
resources.description: Adobe's batch transcoding and rendering application that outputs Premiere Pro and After Effects work to delivery formats in the background.

resources.label: Merchant Productivity Agent
resources.description: Adobe's conversational assistant embedded in the Adobe Commerce Admin through which a merchant carries out merchandising tasks, looks up store data and gets in-context guidance in natural language.

resources.label: Adobe Mix Modeler
resources.description: Adobe's marketing measurement and planning application, combining media-mix modelling with multi-touch attribution to measure and optimise spend across paid, earned and owned channels.

resources.label: Mobile SDK
resources.description: Adobe's mobile-application library that collects app events into the Experience Platform Edge Network and returns audience qualifications and personalised content in-session.

resources.label: Adobe Muse
resources.description: Adobe's former web-design application for building websites visually without writing code.

resources.label: Offer Decisioning
resources.description: The decisioning capability that selects which offer each customer sees from profile attributes and event data, writing its decisions back to the Real-Time Customer Profile for any channel to reuse.

resources.label: OpenAI Ads Integration
resources.description: Adobe Advertising's capability that adds OpenAI Ads, the ChatGPT conversational ad format, as a publisher in Search, Social, & Commerce and as conversational ads in the DSP.

resources.label: Operational Insights Agent
resources.description: Adobe's functional agent, used by the Audience, Journey and Data Engineering agents, that surfaces anomalies and usage across audiences, journeys and datasets.

resources.label: Adobe PDF Accessibility Auto-Tag API
resources.description: Acrobat Services' API that automatically tags a PDF for accessibility — headings, reading order and structure — and checks the result, bundled with the PDF Services API.

resources.label: Adobe PDF Electronic Seal API
resources.description: Acrobat Services' API that applies an organisation's electronic seal to a PDF with a certificate, to establish the document's authenticity and origin at scale, bundled with the PDF Services API.

resources.label: Adobe PDF Embed API
resources.description: Acrobat Services' client-side JavaScript API that embeds a PDF viewer with collaboration and analytics features in a web application.

resources.label: Adobe PDF Extract API
resources.description: Acrobat Services' API that extracts text, tables, images and logical structure from PDFs as JSON for analytics, AI and downstream processing, bundled with the PDF Services API.

resources.label: Import/Export PDF Form Data
resources.description: The PDF Services API operations that import data into, and export data from, the fields of a PDF form.

resources.label: PDF Properties
resources.description: The PDF Services API operation that reads a PDF's metadata and structural information.

resources.label: Adobe PDF Services API
resources.description: Adobe's developer API for programmatic PDF operations — creating, converting, recognising text in, extracting from and manipulating documents inside applications and pipelines.

resources.label: PDF Spaces
resources.description: Acrobat Studio's collaborative knowledge hubs — multi-document collections with AI question-answering grounded in the sources, generated overviews and insight cards.

resources.label: PDF Spaces Sharing
resources.description: The PDF Spaces capability for inviting collaborators into a space so a common set of sources and AI insights is worked on together.

resources.label: PDF Watermark
resources.description: The PDF Services API operation that adds a text or image watermark to a PDF.

resources.label: Adobe PhoneGap Build
resources.description: Adobe's former cloud service that packaged HTML, CSS and JavaScript mobile applications into native app binaries.

resources.label: Adobe Photoshop
resources.description: Adobe's professional raster image-editing and compositing application — layers, masking, retouching and Firefly generative editing.

resources.label: Adobe Photoshop Elements
resources.description: Adobe's consumer photo-editing application with guided edits and automated corrections, sold as an annual release.

resources.label: Adobe Photoshop Express
resources.description: Adobe's lightweight mobile photo-editing application for quick corrections, filters and social-ready output.

resources.label: Adobe Photoshop (web)
resources.description: The browser surface of Photoshop for editing PSDs and making quick generative edits without a desktop install.

resources.label: Places Service
resources.description: The Mobile SDK's location capability that gives apps points of interest and their metadata so that entering or leaving a place can trigger rules and personalisation.

resources.label: Adobe Portfolio
resources.description: Adobe's website builder for personal creative portfolios, included with Creative Cloud membership.

resources.label: Adobe Prelude
resources.description: Adobe's former video-ingest, transcoding and logging application for preparing footage for editing.

resources.label: Adobe Premiere Elements
resources.description: Adobe's consumer video-editing application with guided edits and automated highlight reels, sold as an annual release.

resources.label: Adobe Premiere (Mobile)
resources.description: The mobile surface of Premiere for editing and publishing video on phones and tablets with the Premiere editing model in a touch-first form.

resources.label: Adobe Premiere Pro
resources.description: Adobe's professional non-linear video-editing application — timeline editing, colour, audio and delivery for film, broadcast and online video.

resources.label: Adobe Premiere Rush
resources.description: Adobe's former lightweight video-editing application for quick edits on phones and desktops, replaced by Premiere on mobile and desktop.

resources.label: Presentation Left Red Stripe
resources.description: The fixed Adobe Red vertical stripe at the extreme left edge of Adobe's official presentation template — template chrome and a recognisable Adobe presentation cue, never a general-purpose motif.

resources.label: Experience Platform Privacy Service
resources.description: Experience Platform's service for managing privacy access and delete requests across Experience Platform and Experience Cloud applications, using identity namespaces and Experience Cloud IDs.

resources.label: Product Advisor Agent
resources.description: Adobe's product-recommendation agent in Brand Concierge that advises end customers in real time, using unified profiles, behavioural data and business rules to recommend products, plans or offers.

resources.label: Adobe Product Analytics
resources.description: Experience Platform's analytics application for product usage — user journeys, retention and cohort analysis, and funnels — for optimising digital product experience rather than marketing traffic.

resources.label: Product Knowledge Agent
resources.description: Adobe's functional agent, used by the Product Support Agent and AI Assistant, that answers questions about product documentation and explains product concepts.

resources.label: Product Support Agent
resources.description: Adobe's support agent in the AI Assistant panel of the Experience Platform applications that provides self-serve troubleshooting grounded in product knowledge and the customer's environment and can raise support tickets.

resources.label: Adobe Productivity Agent
resources.description: Adobe's purpose-built agent for business professionals and consumers that combines Acrobat and Express capabilities through a planner, a router and specialised skills to answer questions about documents and carry out multi-step document workflows.

resources.label: Programmatic TV
resources.description: The Advertising DSP's capability for buying television and connected-TV inventory programmatically.

resources.label: Project Halo
resources.description: An AI-first customer-engagement application for mid-market and departmental enterprise teams that turns a text prompt into a foundational, multi-step, pre-branded email campaign — a B2B nurture or a B2C new-member onboarding — with a preview.

resources.label: Protect PDF
resources.description: Acrobat's capability that restricts who can open, copy or edit a PDF, offered as an online tool and as an action in Acrobat and Reader.

resources.label: Experience Platform Query Service
resources.description: Experience Platform's SQL engine over Data Lake datasets, whose results can become new datasets for reporting, machine learning or Profile ingestion.

resources.label: Adobe Real-Time CDP
resources.description: Experience Platform's customer data platform application — unifying known and pseudonymous data into Real-Time Customer Profiles and activating audiences to destinations under governance controls.

resources.label: Adobe Real-Time CDP B2B Edition
resources.description: The B2B edition of Real-Time CDP — unifying person and account profiles and linking leads to accounts and opportunities for account-based segmentation and activation.

resources.label: Adobe Real-Time CDP Collaboration
resources.description: Real-Time CDP's data-collaboration application in which two organisations discover audience overlap and measure campaign outcomes without exchanging their underlying customer databases.

resources.label: Real-Time Customer Profile
resources.description: Experience Platform's unified view of each customer, in which streaming and batch data from all connected sources merge into one profile that updates in real time and powers segmentation, journeys and personalisation.

resources.label: Reporting & Insights
resources.description: The Content Supply Chain stage in which content and campaign performance is measured and fed back into planning.

resources.label: Adobe RoboHelp
resources.description: Adobe's help-authoring application for producing online help, knowledge bases and policy documentation published to web and mobile outputs.

resources.label: Adobe Scan
resources.description: Adobe's mobile scanning application that captures paper documents as searchable, text-recognised PDFs.

resources.label: Experience Platform Schema Registry
resources.description: Experience Platform's modelling service where XDM schemas, classes and field groups are defined, and to which all platform data, profiles and identities conform.

resources.label: Demo and Technical Execution
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey focused on demo mastery, technical talks, integrations, labs, and technical pre-sales execution.

resources.label: Discovery and Qualification
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey focused on discovery, qualification, account planning, and evaluating opportunity fit.

resources.label: Just-in-Time Learning
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey: targeted resources and updates that support learning in the flow of work.

resources.label: Path to Excellence
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey: the technical-oriented learning path used in product enablement materials for technical pre- and post-sales audiences.

resources.label: Path to Readiness
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey: the sales-oriented learning path used in product enablement materials for sellers and general field audiences.

resources.label: Product Foundations
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey: the entry path covering technology, product basics, market need and core product walkthroughs.

resources.label: Value-Driven Deal Progression
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey focused on progressing deals through value-led discovery, objection handling, measurement partnership, and mitigation of risk before close.

resources.label: Value Positioning
resources.description: An Adobe seller learning journey focused on unlocking customer value, target profiles, differentiators, and product value positioning.

resources.label: Commercial Account Seller
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona that owns the commercial outcome on an account or opportunity – account strategy, executive relationships, deal orchestration, and book-of-business growth. Its core learning needs are: customer discovery and qualification; business value articulation and business-case framing; negotiation and commercial progression; account planning and whitespace strategy; executive storytelling and multi-threading.

resources.label: Partner Sales
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona that builds partner GTM, joint pipeline and partner enablement across the ecosystem. Its core learning needs are: partner strategy and joint GTM; partner pipeline creation and whitespace; partner accountability and practice development; enablement of partner sellers.

resources.label: Pipeline Generator
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona that creates and qualifies early-stage pipeline for aligned sellers. Its core learning needs are: prospecting and account-based outreach; early qualification and lead progression; product foundations and value hooks; messaging and objection basics.

resources.label: Post-Sale Growth & Renewal
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona that drives adoption, value realisation, retention, renewal and expansion across the installed base. Its core learning needs are: onboarding and adoption strategy; value realisation and customer outcomes; health and risk signals and escalation; renewal motion and commercial hygiene; expansion and cross-sell identification.

resources.label: Solution Specialist
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona for specialist sellers who bring deep single-solution value, use-case selling and competitive positioning. Its core learning needs are: deep single-solution value proposition; use-case and application selling; competitive differentiation; solution discovery and qualification; scope, pricing and business-case contribution.

resources.label: Technical Pre-Sales
resources.description: An Adobe seller learner persona that wins the technical decision – technical discovery, demo mastery, validation, and architecture guidance. Its core learning needs are: technical discovery and requirements shaping; demo mastery and technical storytelling; technical validation and proof; architecture patterns and integration (architect tier); strong pre-sales to post-sales handoff.

resources.label: Account Director
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the core sellers and account owners family responsible for overall account leadership, ecosystem orchestration, executive relationships, forecast discipline; it resolves to the Commercial Account Seller learner persona.

resources.label: Account Executive
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the core sellers and account owners family responsible for commercial growth and deal ownership; opportunity progression, qualification, negotiation, pipeline creation; it resolves to the Commercial Account Seller learner persona.

resources.label: Account Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the core sellers and account owners family responsible for book-of-business ownership for named / installed-base accounts; relationship management, whitespace, renewal readiness; it resolves to the Commercial Account Seller learner persona. NAM (Named Account Manager) is a coverage label on this family, not a distinct role.

resources.label: Business Development Representative
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the pipeline generation family responsible for outbound prospecting, qualification, account-based outreach; it resolves to the Pipeline Generator learner persona.

resources.label: Campaign Operations
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for campaign setup and execution coordination across sales, demand, and business systems to support timely campaign delivery; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Marketing operations cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Channel Account Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the partner sales family that builds and maintains channel-partner relationships to drive indirect sales; supports quote / pricing, partner enablement, reseller growth, renewals, and expansion through the channel; it resolves to the Partner Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Compensation and Territory Operations
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for territory alignment, compensation-impacting data and processes, and coverage attribution support; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Customer Business Advisor
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the specialist overlays family: an advisory specialist who shapes solution strategy with the customer; it resolves to the Solution Specialist learner persona.

resources.label: Customer Engineer
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the adjacent and overlay roles family: a support and engineering role; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning.

resources.label: Customer Retention Marketing
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for adoption, advocacy, retention, and expansion-support campaigns for existing customers; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Customer-marketing cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Customer Success Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the post-sale growth and value family responsible for adoption, value realisation, health / risk mitigation, QBRs, retention support, and advocacy; it resolves to the Post-Sale Growth & Renewal learner persona.

resources.label: Customer Success Specialist
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the post-sale growth and value family responsible for time-bound or specialist success engagements focused on adoption, value measurement, and post-sales guidance; it resolves to the Post-Sale Growth & Renewal learner persona.

resources.label: Data Steward
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for data-quality stewardship for opportunities, contracts, coverage, and reporting-critical sales data; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Deal Desk
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for contract drafting and changes, deal-structure review, and coordination with finance and bookings teams before processing; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Demand Generation
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for campaign planning and execution to create new-business leads, increase engagement, and pass qualified leads to sales; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Marketing cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Digital Strategy Group
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the adjacent and overlay roles family: an advisory support function covering industry trends, best practice, thought leadership and strategic point of view, not a field-selling role; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Its enablement need (industry trends, best practice, thought leadership) is distinct from the seller personas; it is the strongest candidate for its own learner persona if dedicated enablement is later designed for it.

resources.label: Enterprise Architect
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the technical pre-sales family responsible for future-state architecture, integration patterns, scalability, executive technical credibility; it resolves to the Technical Pre-Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Expert SC
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the technical pre-sales family responsible for expert-level features, tailored demos, hardest customer scenarios; it resolves to the Technical Pre-Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Field Partner Sales Manager
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the partner sales family that develops and executes partner strategy for aligned sales teams; defines territory plans; drives partner alignment in whitespace; represents the partner point of view on deal progression; serves as primary partner contact for field teams; provides reporting and quarterly reviews; drives joint close-plan accountability; it resolves to the Partner Sales learner persona.

resources.label: Global Account Director
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the core sellers and account owners family responsible for global / multi-BU account leadership across regions; it resolves to the Commercial Account Seller learner persona.

resources.label: Inside Sales Representative
resources.description: A legacy, overloaded Adobe field label that names a territory-carrying role or an overlay role in DMe and sits near renewals or support in older DX material. It is never resolved to a learner persona without the business unit confirming which role is meant; the candidates are Pipeline Generator, Commercial Account Seller and Post-Sale Growth & Renewal.

resources.label: Internal Sales Operations Help Desk
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the operations and change family responsible for frontline support for sales-ops issues, access, and process troubleshooting; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Operational support cohort for readiness and communications.

resources.label: Marketing Data Analyst
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for campaign and engagement reporting, performance visibility, and insight support for marketing programmes; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Marketing analytics cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Marketing Data Product Owner
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for product / data ownership for marketing-data capabilities, standards, and system-backed workflows; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. Marketing data-governance cohort retained for communications and readiness planning.

resources.label: Marketing Operations
resources.description: An Adobe field role in the marketing family responsible for marketing-technology configuration, process / workflow design, campaign-system coordination, and lead-management support; it is not a learner persona and is retained for communications, readiness and change planning. resources.description: High energy and engagement but may lack deep substance or structured logical flow.

resources.label: Speaker Technocrat
resources.description: High expertise but low engagement; focuses on data and logic over narrative or emotional connection.

resources.label: Speaker Visionary
resources.description: Elite-level speaker combining deep expertise with high engagement, using agentic language and tricolons.

resources.label: Speculative Scenario
resources.description: Scenario where learners predict future outcomes based on current trends and intuition.

resources.label: Standard Error Measurement
resources.description: Metric (SEM) providing a concrete unit of measure for the uncertainty surrounding a score, allowing for the construction of confidence intervals.

resources.label: Star Moment
resources.description: Something They'll Always Remember; a planned, high-impact event (Dramatization, Sound Bite, Visual, Story, or Statistic) that drives the message home.

resources.label: Statistic Hook
resources.description: Leads with surprising statistic or data point (von Restorff effect)

resources.label: Stealth Assessment
resources.description: Shute's framework measuring competence unobtrusively from continuous telemetry inside games and simulations, via Evidence-Centred Design models and a governed Q-matrix.

resources.label: Stereotype Content Model
resources.description: Stereotype Content Model (SCM) speaker evaluation framework — two primary perception dimensions that determine audience response

resources.label: Storage Strength
resources.description: Property of memory (NTD) measuring how well-learned and interconnected a memory is; characterized by permanence.

resources.label: Story Hook
resources.description: Begins with brief, vivid anecdote (narrative transportation)

resources.label: Story Spine
resources.description: Adams's nine-step causal narrative template, from "Once upon a time" to "the moral is", enforcing because-of-that causal coherence (1991); commonly misattributed to Pixar.

resources.label: Storyboard Element
resources.description: Components of storyboard documents used in pre-production planning

resources.label: Strategic Pause
resources.description: Deliberate silence placed after a key assertion so the audience can consolidate it before the speaker moves on; its duration band is library knowledge.

resources.label: Strip Card Methodology
resources.description: Hierarchical design system using strips and their component cards to manage cognitive load and flow; their duration bands are library knowledge.

resources.label: Structural Slide
resources.description: References to structural diagram slides including architecture stacks, hub-spoke, cycles, process flows, hierarchies, and timelines

resources.label: Structure Dimension
resources.description: Reference to structure, organisation, or narrative flow as a quality dimension

resources.label: Style Frame
resources.description: An original full-fidelity still rendered in a project's own visual language that proves a motion piece's intended look before animation begins.

resources.label: Subordination Marker
resources.description: Conjunction introducing subordinate clause (increases syntactic complexity)

resources.label: SUCCES Framework
resources.description: The Heath brothers' six stickiness attributes — Simple, Unexpected, Concrete, Credible, Emotional, Stories — countering the Curse of Knowledge (2007).

resources.label: Summary Marker
resources.description: Lexical marker signalling summary or conclusion

resources.label: Summative Assessment
resources.description: Assessment conducted at the end of a learning unit to evaluate overall achievement

resources.label: Summative Assessment Capstone
resources.description: References to terminal summative assessment structures within course architecture — capstone demos, graded case analyses, portfolio submissions

resources.label: Surprisal Oscillation
resources.description: A two-phase engagement pattern alternating low-surprisal anchors with high-surprisal spikes

resources.label: Synchronous Delivery Block
resources.description: References to real-time, instructor-led or peer-to-peer content delivery blocks within a course architecture

resources.label: Synchronous Learning
resources.description: Live, real-time learning involving simultaneous participation of students and instructors.

resources.label: Synonymy Signal
resources.description: Use of synonymous or near-synonymous terms across EDU boundaries maintaining referential continuity without explicit coreference

resources.label: Synthetic Presenter
resources.description: An AI-generated on-screen instructor (avatar) that delivers scripted instruction in place of a filmed human presenter.

resources.label: System Dynamics Visualisation
resources.description: Narrating dynamic systems through causal loop and stock-and-flow diagrams — loop polarity notation, system archetypes, and interactive simulation patterns.

resources.label: Target Speaking Rate
resources.description: Speech velocity a delivery context calls for, expressed as a band rather than a point; the band differs between live conversational, live persuasive and narrated instructional delivery and is bounded above by the rate at which listeners can no longer process what is said. Which band applies is a measured finding owned by the evidence and by the tool that measures speech, not by this definition.

resources.label: Tbox Abox Distinction
resources.description: Ontological distinction between the Terminological Box (Schema/Classes) and the Assertional Box (Individuals/Instances).

resources.label: Technical Hackathon
resources.description: References to hackathon-style collaborative creation events for building technical solutions or prototypes

resources.label: Temporal Contiguity Principle
resources.description: Present corresponding narration and visuals simultaneously rather than sequentially.

resources.label: Temporal Marker
resources.description: Lexical marker signalling temporal sequence or time frame

resources.label: Ten Two Rule
resources.description: Webinar design principle alternating a block of instruction with a short block of active retrieval, in the proportions its name fixes. The retrieval breaks are supported by interpolated-testing evidence; the fixed cadence inherits the contested lecture-attention-span claim, which has no direct empirical support as a hard attention limit.

resources.label: Testimonial Marker
resources.description: Testimonial and quote attribution from customers or experts

resources.label: Testing Effect
resources.description: The phenomenon where the act of retrieving information from memory (testing) enhances long-term retention more effectively than restudying.

resources.label: Text Density Marker
resources.description: Visual anti-patterns that increase cognitive load — detectable signals of split-attention, redundancy effect, wall-of-text, and bullet overload violations of Cognitive Load Theory

resources.label: Text Size Violation
resources.description: Font size below minimum legibility threshold for the delivery context

resources.label: Thematic Analysis
resources.description: umbrella term for a family of qualitative methods for identifying, analysing, and reporting patterns (themes) within a dataset.

resources.label: Theory of Mind
resources.description: The capacity to attribute unobservable mental states — beliefs, desires, intentions, emotions — to oneself and others (Premack and Woodruff 1978).

resources.label: Three Cs Scenario Design
resources.description: The Challenge-Choices-Consequences framework for designing a single realistic decision scenario — an authentic challenge, plausible trade-off choices, and feedback-bearing consequences.

resources.label: Threshold Guardian
resources.description: A test, barrier, or gatekeeper that must be passed before progress can continue

resources.label: Theory-of-Mind Prompting Architectures
resources.description: Prompting architectures for Theory-of-Mind perspective-taking in LLMs — SimToM, Decompose-ToM, EnigmaToM and ToMAP — that isolate or decompose an agent's epistemic state before inference.

resources.label: Tone Prompt Dictionary
resources.description: Structured mapping system translating quantitative acoustic/visual triggers into qualitative prompt instructions for AI coaching.

resources.label: Topic Modelling
resources.description: Unsupervised discovery of latent themes in a text corpus by inferring topic mixtures from co-occurrence or embedding structure, validated by coherence and stability metrics.

resources.label: Topic Shift Marker
resources.description: Lexical marker signalling shift to new topic or section

resources.label: Transition Marker
resources.description: Discourse connectives signaling topic or section shifts

resources.label: Transition Phrase
resources.description: Phrases that signal structural transitions between content sections

resources.label: Trickster
resources.description: A character who disrupts the status quo, challenges assumptions, or introduces unexpected change

resources.label: Tricolon
resources.description: Three parallel words, phrases, or clauses creating rhythm and memorability

resources.label: Tricolon Marker
resources.description: Three parallel words, phrases, or clauses (rule of three)

resources.label: Triple Constraints
resources.description: Core project management framework balancing Cost, Time, and Quality to define success.

resources.label: Tuckman Group Development
resources.description: Tuckman's five-stage group-development model (Forming, Storming, Norming, Performing, Adjourning), qualified by non-linear and regressive alternatives such as Gersick's punctuated equilibrium.

resources.label: Two Click Ten Second Rule
resources.description: Usability heuristic for performance support: a solution must be reachable within the click count and actionable within the seconds its name fixes.

resources.label: Typography Element
resources.description: Font and text styling references

resources.label: Universal Design for Learning
resources.description: CAST's Universal Design for Learning framework — inclusive design through multiple means of Engagement, Representation, and Action and Expression, with guideline checkpoints.

resources.label: Understand Verb
resources.description: Bloom's Level 2 action verbs indicating comprehension-level learning objectives

resources.label: Unmeasurable Verb
resources.description: Vague or unmeasurable verbs that indicate poorly-written learning objectives

resources.label: Unyk Rule
resources.description: Rule stating that items are unique and each should represent a single clearly identifiable concept.

resources.label: Uptalk Indicator
resources.description: Markers of High Rising Terminal (HRT) that undermine speaker authority

resources.label: Urgency Marker
resources.description: Urgency and scarcity language creating time pressure

resources.label: Validated Outcome
resources.description: Independently verified or audited result — highest evidence quality tier; required for passing the evidence specificity gate

resources.label: Value Proposition
resources.description: Statements of unique benefit or competitive advantage

resources.label: Vendor As Mentor
resources.description: The vendor or solution provider cast in the mentor role — enabling rather than heroic

resources.label: Verbs Plus Anchor
resources.description: Narrative atomic units including canonical verbs and event-denoting nominals (e.g., 'marriage', 'hesitation').

resources.label: Video Edit Transition
resources.description: Post-production transition and editing techniques between video segments

resources.label: Video Shot Type
resources.description: Camera shot types and framing conventions used in video production

resources.label: Villain
resources.description: The force of opposition — could be a competitor, market condition, or internal resistance

resources.label: Virtual Lab
resources.description: References to virtual lab or sandbox environments for hands-on experimentation with systems or software

resources.label: Virtual Platform Feature
resources.description: Virtual meeting platform features used for instructional delivery

resources.label: Visionary Bundle
resources.description: 4-word formulaic phrase characteristic of engaging, visionary speakers

resources.label: Vista Space Model
resources.description: 3D narrative topology framework defining STORY not as a line, but as a movement through Impulse, Resonance, and Pause axes.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Document Page
resources.description: Layout standard for the A4 document page frame family; its dimensions and margins are the library's document page layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Flowchart
resources.description: Layout standard for the flowchart frame family; its default canvas and node measurements are the library's flowchart layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Hero Banner
resources.description: Layout standard for the hero banner frame family; its dimensions are the library's hero banner layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Interactive Scenario
resources.description: Layout standard for the interactive branching scenario frame family; its dimensions, controls and design bounds are the library's interactive scenario layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Knowledge Organiser
resources.description: Layout standard for the landscape A4 knowledge organiser frame family; its page, grid, banner and card measurements are the library's knowledge organiser layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Lottie Animation
resources.description: Layout standard for the Lottie animation frame family; its default canvas is the library's Lottie animation layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Master Sow
resources.description: Layout standard for the landscape A4 master scheme-of-work frame family; its page, banner, strip, section, table, chip and row measurements and design bounds are the library's master scheme-of-work layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Presentation Slide
resources.description: Layout standard for the widescreen presentation slide frame family; its dimensions and safe margins are the library's presentation slide layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Puzzles
resources.description: Layout standard for the word-search, sudoku and crossword puzzle frame families; their cell, stroke and type measurements are the library's puzzle layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Quizzes
resources.description: Layout standard for the quiz frame family; its spacing, touch targets and design bounds are the library's quiz layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Retrieval Grid
resources.description: Layout standard for the portrait A4 retrieval grid frame family; its page, grid, banner, cell and token measurements are the library's retrieval grid layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Svg Canvas
resources.description: Layout standard for the SVG canvas frame family; its default canvas and type sizes are the library's SVG canvas layout specification.

resources.label: Layout Spec: Timeline
resources.description: Layout standard for the timeline frame family; its default canvas and item measurements are the library's timeline layout specification.

resources.label: Visual Style: Design
resources.description: The layer of a brand's guidance that fixes how outputs are constructed — grids, components, detailed layouts, production mechanics, templates, crop ratios and implementation specifications — as distinct from the brand's style.

resources.label: Visual Style: Style
resources.description: The layer of a brand's guidance that fixes its recognisable visual and verbal character — colour behaviour, type character, imagery point of view, motion and video feel, mark treatment and overall expression — as distinct from how outputs are constructed.

resources.label: Visual Style: Tone Of Voice
resources.description: The sibling style layer that fixes how a brand sounds in language, kept aligned with its visual style but structured separately so that written behaviour is not confused with visual design rules.

resources.label: Resolution
resources.description: The display density, pixel dimension, and optical clarity of layout and image assets.

resources.label: Scaffolding
resources.description: The underlying modular grid, column hierarchy, and visual structure organizing slide elements.

resources.label: Visual Content Format
resources.description: References to visual content formats like infographics, slide decks, and data visualisations

resources.label: Visual Demonstration
resources.description: Marker signalling that visual evidence is being presented (chart, graph, diagram)

resources.label: Visual Element
resources.description: Individual design elements and components

resources.label: Visual Modality Decision
resources.description: The first-order choice of which visual modality a message needs — a seven-category taxonomy of photo, illustration, icon, chart, diagram, screenshot and table, with a decision tree and the realism-abstraction trade-off.

resources.label: Visual Narrative Element
resources.description: Slide-level narrative elements that signal structured argumentation — action titles, dot-dash logic, SCQA visual structure, and annotation markers

resources.label: Visual Quality Dimension
resources.description: Reference to visual design, layout, or aesthetic quality as a scoring dimension

resources.label: Visualisation Generation Pipeline
resources.description: AI-driven visualisation generation pipeline for automated chart/diagram creation in learning content

resources.label: Vocal Emphasis Marker
resources.description: Text formatting indicating vocal emphasis in speaker scripts

resources.label: Vocal Hedge Marker
resources.description: Language that weakens assertions and undermines speaker certainty

resources.label: Vocal Quality Issue
resources.description: Terms indicating voice quality problems requiring coaching or clinical attention

resources.label: Voice Principle
resources.description: Prefer a friendly, human-sounding voice over a robotic monotone. The classic human-beats-machine finding has reversed under modern neural TTS — current studies find no reliable learning penalty for high-quality synthetic voices — so the principle rules out legacy robotic monotone, not contemporary TTS.

resources.label: Warrant
resources.description: Logical bridges connecting evidence to claims

resources.label: Wcag 2 2 Standard
resources.description: Global accessibility standard ensuring learning content is usable by people with disabilities.

resources.label: Webinar Format
resources.description: References to webinar, broadcast, and live online event formats

resources.label: White Space
resources.description: An active design tool, not empty space. Functions include isolating elements, providing breathing room, and strengthening focal points by eliminating nearby attention competitors; its recommended share of slide area and margin widths are library knowledge.

resources.label: Whiteboarding
resources.description: Visual facilitation as cognitive practice — shared boards as working-memory offload, session methodologies, scribing mechanics, sketchnote grammar and sketching as a generative thinking medium.

resources.label: Working Memory Marker
resources.description: References to working memory limitations, Miller's Law, and capacity constraints in instructional design

resources.label: Wpw Facilitation
resources.description: Whole-Part-Whole facilitation methodology for structured learning delivery.

resources.label: Zpd
resources.description: Vygotsky's Zone of Proximal Development; the gap between what a learner can do alone and what they can achieve with guidance.
